# sonarqube_setting (Resource)

One setting, global or on a component. Destroying it resets the setting to its inherited or default value. Do not also manage a component's settings with `setting` blocks of `sonarqube_project` or `sonarqube_portfolio`, which are authoritative. Import ID: `key` or `key:component`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A global single-value setting.
resource "sonarqube_setting" "base_url" {
  key   = "sonar.core.serverBaseURL"
  value = "https://sonarqube.example.com"
}

# A multi-value setting on one project.
resource "sonarqube_setting" "api_exclusions" {
  key       = "sonar.exclusions"
  component = "example-api"
  values    = ["**/generated/**"]
}

# A property-set setting.
resource "sonarqube_setting" "issue_ignore" {
  key = "sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria"
  field_values = [
    { ruleKey = "java:S1135", resourceKey = "**/legacy/**" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Setting key.

### Optional

- `component` (String) Project, application or portfolio key. Omit for a global setting.
- `field_values` (List of Map of String) Field values of a property-set setting. Must not be empty; destroy the resource to reset the setting.
- `value` (String) Value of a single-value setting. Must not be empty; destroy the resource to reset the setting.
- `values` (List of String) Values of a multi-value setting. Must not be empty; destroy the resource to reset the setting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_setting.example 'sonar.exclusions:example-api'
```
